paragraph:
This is an automated hazard-exposure briefing produced by Riprap from live and baked data sources. It is informational only and not a substitute for a professional risk assessment.

**Hazard Reader.**
This address sits within the empirical 2012 Hurricane Sandy inundation footprint (NYC OEM) [sandy_inundation]. This address sits in FEMA flood zone AE (a Special Flood Hazard Area), per NFHL FIRM panel 3604970192F, effective 2007 [fema_nfhl]. This address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario (3.66 in/hr, 2080 SLR) [dep_extreme_2080]. This address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario (2.13 in/hr, 2050 SLR) [dep_moderate_2050]. This address is outside the modeled flooding in the NYC DEP stormwater scenario (2.13 in/hr, current SLR) [dep_moderate_current]. USGS surveyed 1 Hurricane Ida high-water mark(s) within 800 m of this address; the highest stood 0.3 ft above ground; the highest water surface elevation was 4.2 ft NAVD88 [ida_hwm]. Nearest mark: Visitation Pl., between Van Brunt St. and Richards St., Red Hook, Brooklyn (130 m away) [ida_hwm]. Experimental: satellite-detected surface water about 14 hours after Hurricane Ida (Sentinel-2, 2021-09-02): 0 water polygons within 500 m of this address, nearest 4026.3 m away [prithvi_water]. Most are marsh, shoreline and park water; street and basement flooding had drained by then and is not visible in this layer. Elevation 1.37 m; this point sits at the 0.8th percentile of elevation within a 200 m window (lower percentile = topographic low); HAND 3.81 m above nearest drainage; TWI 14.79 [microtopo]. Local basin relief: 13.27 m [microtopo]. Experimental: Policy passages retrieved from the NYC flood-policy corpus for this place: 1 (embedding retrieval; entity tags are experimental) [policy_corpus].

**Live Observer.**
6 FloodNet community sensor(s) within 600 m have logged 9 above-curb flood event(s) in the last 3 years [floodnet]. Peak depth recorded by these sensors: 89 mm [floodnet]. 60 NYC 311 flood-related complaints filed within 200 m of this location in the last 5 years [nyc311]. Most common descriptor: Catch Basin Clogged/Flooding (Use Comments) (SC). Latest METAR at Central Park, NY (11.8 km away): 13.9°C, 1.5 mm precip in the last hour (obs 2026-09-27T00:51) [nws_obs]. Latest reading at The Battery, NY: 7.16 ft above MLLW (+1.9 ft vs predicted tide), observed 2026-09-26 21:42 [noaa_tides].

**Asset Register.**
0 MTA subway entrances within 800 m of this address: 0 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 0 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise) [mta_entrance_exposure]. 2 NYCHA developments within 2000 m of this address: 2 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 0 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise) [nycha_development_exposure]. 2 NYC DOE schools within 1500 m of this address: 2 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 0 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise) [doe_school_exposure]. 2 hospitals within 3000 m of this address: 0 inside the 2012 Sandy inundation extent and 0 inside the DEP extreme stormwater scenario (2080 sea-level rise) [doh_hospital_exposure].

**Projector.**
3 active NWS alerts at this point: Coastal Flood Warning (Severe), High Surf Advisory (Minor), Rip Current Statement (Moderate) [nws_alerts]. Experimental: a TTM model fine-tuned on Battery gauge history, with no wind or pressure input, forecasts a peak surge residual of 0.53 m at The Battery about 4 h ahead [ttm_battery_surge]. Use NOAA ETSS or the Stevens Flood Advisory System for storm decisions. Experimental: 6 flood-related 311 complaints within 200 m over the last 512 days; a zero-shot TTM forecast with no rainfall input and no backtest projects about 0.02 per week for the next 96 days [ttm_311_forecast]. NPCC4 (2024) projects sea-level rise at the Battery of 0.38 m (15 in) by the 2050s and 0.79 m (31 in) by 2100 at the median, relative to 2000-2004; 90th percentile 0.74 m and 1.65 m [npcc4_slr].

**Out of scope.** This briefing does not assess title, structural condition, or compliance with specific zoning rules. Where a probe was offline at run time, the relevant section omits that signal.
